en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large late‑19th‑century military barracks complex along a tree‑lined street. The multi‑story brick buildings have steep tiled roofs, gables, and decorative facades, enclosed by an iron fence and stone wall. The perspective is from across a cobbled street with young trees and a small planted traffic island in the foreground. Printed German text in red appears along the top margin, identifying the location and the military unit housed there.
